card.name: Distributive words: each, per, several
card.fires_on: Words that spread a quantity across units, such as each, per, and several, or the word be after multiple. Seen after a count of items like pledgets, patches, syringes, or plants.

modes.label: each / per
modes.description: The distributing word each or per follows a count and names the unit it applies to.
modes.example: Apply no more than four patches<< per>> day.

modes.label: Plural or multiple setup
modes.description: A word like several or be (after multiple or may) that sets up a repeated item.
modes.example: Multiple INMAZEB vials may<< be>> needed.

modes.label: Inside unit nouns
modes.description: Partway through a unit noun such as syringes or nostril, right before an each or per phrase.
modes.example: 2 syring<<es>> with 3 mL in each syringe
